notes.614: OSM gives this building only a number or placeholder name and no use, and no official list names it, so it can't be told apart as a class building.
notes.new-north-campus: One entry for four North Campus halls; pin is the mean of OSM's Hu Shih Hall, Toni Morrison Hall, Ruth Bader Ginsburg Hall (north and south) and McClintock Hall centroids (ways 931488905, 931491817, 931488900, 931488899, 931488904).
notes.low-rises: Midpoint of OSM's Low Rise 6 and Low Rise 7 (ways 403931135, 403931136).
notes.west-campus-houses: One entry for five West Campus houses; pin is the mean of OSM's Carl Becker, Hans Bethe, Alice Cook, William T Keeton and Flora Rose House centroids (ways 540527775, 324135852, 216649615, 216649559, 324135849), so its minutes are approximate for any one house.

detours.why: Fall Creek gorge lies between North Campus and Olin Laboratory; walks cross on the mapped footbridge east of Risley, and Olin (way/116671008) has no mapped entrance, its centre snapping to the service drive off Sciences Drive on its south side.
